summary: Firefox’s 2D graphics and font code was cleaned up to represent CSS font features such as font-variant-caps, font-variant-position, font-variant-emoji, and variation settings more consistently. Font metrics and locking were simplified and made safer, while color-font palette allocation now fails gracefully instead of risking an out-of-memory crash. Platform-specific changes adjust Android font API usage and gate Skrifa font initialization behind a runtime preference.
